reply.text:
I'm not going to rank them. SARMs are unapproved research chemicals, so there's no "least sketchy" one. What's in the bottle from a guy selling them is anyone's guess, and the dosing and risks are a doctor's territory, not mine. If you're thinking about taking something, talk to a doctor first, ideally one who can run bloodwork.

I can help with the training side. If progress has stalled, tell me which lift and I'll pull your numbers and we'll look at what's really holding it back.
